messages:
lina: Hey team — opened a PR to update the Console observability docs with new dashboards + tracing hooks. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4825 Can someone pick up review?

miguel: I'll take a look in ~30m. Is this just docs edits or are there code snippets to verify?

lina: Mostly docs, a tiny SDK snippet for the tracing hook and a migration note about the cost/latency breakdowns changing names (cost->unit_cost, latency->p50/p95). Also updated a dashboard screenshot (assets/console/dashboards/observability_v2.png).

sam: Quick heads-up — doc-build-bot just failed on a different branch because of an absolute link that breaks staging. If you used absolute paths, switch to relative or use the {{site.baseurl}} helper.

lina: Thanks — I used relative links but missed one in metrics.md. Fixing now.

doc-build-bot: build failed for PR #4825 — broken link detected: /console/metrics/old-costs -> 404

lina: updated metrics.md to point to /console/metrics/unit-costs and pushed to the branch. CI re-run requested.

anya: for the SDK snippet can you use the new event listener API we shipped? Example in my branch. If you paste that it will be easier for users.

lina: good call. Proposed snippet: 
// docs/snippets/tracing-hook.js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
client.on('response', (res) => {
  tracer.addSpan({ id: res.request_id, latency_ms: res.latency_ms, model: res.model });
});

miguel: reviewed the prose. Two tiny suggestions: 1) under "Dashboards -> Cost" mention the new unit_cost metric and show formula: unit_cost = tokens * model_unit_price. 2) update the alt text for the screenshot (missed accessibility).

lina: done — added formula and updated alt text to "Observability dashboard showing unit_cost and latency percentiles". Also added a short migration guide: 
- rename cost -> unit_cost
- replace latency -> p50/p95 columns
- update any routing policies referencing `latency` to use `p50`

sam: LGTM for content. One more check: links to tracing SDK page should open in a new tab on the docs site; we use target="_blank" in the HTML include. Confirmed?

lina: yep using the standard include.

miguel: CI passed for me locally when building the static site. Pushed an approval comment.

doc-build-bot: build passed for PR #4825 — docs site preview: https://deploy-preview-4825--docs.redwood.com/console/observability

anya: small nit: in the tracing snippet, maybe include a tiny comment about sample rate to avoid noise in dashboards.

lina: added a second tiny snippet showing sampling: 
// sample 10% of responses
if (Math.random() < 0.1) {
  tracer.addSpan(...);
}

sam: perfect. Approving now.

miguel: Approved.

lina: Thanks everyone. I'll merge after the final CI preview link is stable, and then notify release-notes to pick up the migration bullet. :tada:

sam: Thanks — can you add a short note in the Console changelog entry so customers see the metric name changes?

lina: will do. Added to changelog and assigned to release-notes.

anya: thanks for the quick turnaround!

lina: merging — PR merged and deploy scheduled. Notifying #all-hands once live. :)
